name: jpganeriwala-hpcl
description: M/s Jay Prakash Ganeriwala — HPCL CFA site (Go + Postgres API, Vite + React client)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "cd services/api && go run ./cmd/server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: cd services/api && go mod download && cd ../../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && cd services/api && go build ./...
